memories.title: Local Postgres listens on port 5433
memories.content: The payments-api dev database runs in Docker on 127.0.0.1:5433, not 5432, because 5432 is taken by the shared analytics Postgres. DATABASE_URL in .env.example reflects this.

memories.title: Store money as integer cents, never floats
memories.content: Decided 2026-10-02: all amounts are int64 minor units (cents) with an ISO 4217 currency column. Floats caused a 1-cent rounding bug in refunds (incident INC-212). Use the money package for formatting.

memories.title: Every POST to /charges requires an Idempotency-Key
memories.content: Clients must send an Idempotency-Key header on POST /charges and POST /refunds. Keys are stored for 24 hours in the idempotency_keys table; a replay returns the original response with status 200. Reason: mobile clients retry on flaky networks and created duplicate charges.

memories.title: Test Stripe webhooks with stripe listen, not ngrok
memories.content: Run `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:8080/webhooks/stripe` and copy the whsec_ signing secret it prints into .env as STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. ngrok URLs changed on every restart and broke the dashboard config.

memories.title: API errors use snake_case codes from errors.go
memories.content: Return errors as {"error": {"code": "card_declined", "message": "..."}}. Codes are defined once in internal/apierr/errors.go; never invent a code inline. The mobile app switches on code, so renaming one is a breaking change.

memories.title: Run migrations as a separate job before the rollout
memories.content: Deploys run `make migrate` as a Kubernetes Job before the Deployment rolls. Migrations must be backward compatible with the previous release (expand, then contract). The 2026-09 outage came from dropping a column in the same release that stopped reading it.

memories.title: Prefer table-driven tests with t.Run subtests
memories.content: Write Go tests as table-driven cases with named t.Run subtests and testify's require for fatal checks. Keep fixtures in testdata/. Stated by the user after a review of the refunds package.

memories.title: Conventional commits, imperative mood, no ticket in subject
memories.content: Commit subjects follow Conventional Commits (feat, fix, docs, refactor) in the imperative mood. Ticket ids go in the body, not the subject.

memories.title: On-call runbook lives in Notion under Payments / Runbooks
memories.content: The on-call runbook for payments-api (stuck payouts, webhook backlog, Stripe outages) is in Notion: Payments / Runbooks. Grafana dashboard: Payments Overview.

memories.title: Rate limits use Redis sliding windows, 100 req/min per key
memories.content: Per-API-key rate limiting is a Redis sliding window (ZSET per key), 100 requests per minute, configured in config/ratelimit.yaml. Bypass with the internal service token only.
